arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Phillips argued Congress made employer sanctions central to immigration policy.
He stated federal law broadly preempted state and local sanctions.
He noted the only exception was a parenthetical for licensing laws.
Ms. O'Grady argued states traditionally regulate employer conduct through police powers.

paragraphs: The outcome defines the boundary between federal immigration control and state regulatory authority. It determines whether states can use licensing tools to enforce labor standards. This shapes how employers operate across state lines. It impacts the balance of power in national immigration enforcement.
